title: Mooney--Rivlin material-path and Explicit-consumer contract
purpose: Freeze the Wang--Fineberg--Needleman Eq. (17) sheet energy, its first-Piola derivative and acoustic scale, and prove that the same material is consumed by the public finite-strain Explicit and cohesive-benchmark paths.

execution.evidence: Independent material-point energy/stress/tangent checks are combined with public-provider and injected weak-interface smoke tests.

observables: Eq. (17) stored energy for a non-diagonal positive-J deformation gradient.
Numerical first-Piola stress and finite-difference material tangent.
Undeformed incremental shear-wave speed and finite-strain Explicit energy.
Preload transfer through the reusable weak-interface benchmark with a Mooney--Rivlin bulk material.
acceptance: The implemented energy equals the independently evaluated Eq. (17) expression.
The material tangent agrees with centered differences of first-Piola stress.
The reference shear-wave speed agrees with sqrt(mu/rho).
Public Explicit and cohesive-benchmark consumers run without changing their workflow contract.

quantities.name: first_piola
quantities.description: Row-major centered energy derivative for the versioned non-diagonal sheet deformation.

quantities.name: reference_shear_wave_speed
quantities.description: sqrt(mu/rho) for mu=500.5 kPa and rho=1020 kg/m^3.

limitations: This is a constitutive/numerical implementation contract, not validation against the paper's experimental curves.
The V4 convergence Golden remains Neo-Hookean unless a separate Mooney--Rivlin parameter study is explicitly executed and versioned.
Publication reproduction still requires geometry, cohesive law, loading history, mesh and post-processing evidence.
